shots.title: Chapter 3 Title Card
shots.spoken_clause: [CHAPTER 3: THE ECONOMY OF AVAILABILITY]
shots.visual_composition_16_9: Centered heavy ink typography: `"CHAPTER 03: THE ECONOMY OF AVAILABILITY"`. Below it, an economic supply and demand graph with intersecting curves in slate blue and gold. Acoustic thud.
shots.camera_movement: Static hold.
shots.psychological_intent:
Signals the transition to sociology and power dynamics.

---

shots.title: Social Supply & Demand
shots.spoken_clause: Beyond dopamine, there is a second fundamental law at work: the Law of Social Supply and Demand.
shots.visual_composition_16_9: A large blackboard on the wall. A red chalk arrow points downward labeled `"HIGH SUPPLY"`; a gold chalk arrow points upward labeled `"HIGH VALUE"`. The two arrows never touch.
shots.camera_movement: Pan from the red arrow to the gold arrow.
shots.psychological_intent:
Connects microeconomics directly to dating dynamics.

---

shots.title: Unspoken Power Dynamics
shots.spoken_clause: Every social interaction carries an unspoken power dynamic.
shots.visual_composition_16_9: Two stickmen standing across from each other having a casual conversation. Above them, subtle hand-drawn chess pieces (King, Pawn) hover invisibly over their heads.
shots.camera_movement: Slow tracking shot passing between the two figures.
shots.psychological_intent:
Reveals the invisible status games running beneath ordinary conversations.

---

shots.title: Social Exchange Theory
shots.spoken_clause: Psychologist George Homans called this Social Exchange Theory.
shots.visual_composition_16_9: An academic chalkboard with a portrait sketch of George Homans and the title: `"SOCIAL EXCHANGE THEORY (1958)"`. Below it: `"Relationships = Cost-Benefit Analysis"`.
shots.camera_movement: Slow push-in on the formula.
shots.psychological_intent:
Establishes credible psychological grounding.

---

shots.title: The Principle of Least Interest
shots.spoken_clause: In any relationship between two people, the person who has the least investment in the outcome holds the most leverage.
shots.visual_composition_16_9: A see-saw balance beam. On the high end sits Person A holding a mountain of heavy baggage labeled `"DESPERATE FOR APPROVAL"`. On the grounded, commanding low end sits Person B holding a single cup of tea, completely relaxed.
shots.camera_movement: Slow tilt from the high, helpless side down to the grounded, powerful side.
shots.psychological_intent:
Willard Waller’s famous Principle of Least Interest visualized with brutal clarity.

---

shots.title: The College Group Project
shots.spoken_clause: Imagine two students working on a group presentation in college.
shots.visual_composition_16_9: A campus study desk with two laptops open side-by-side. On the left sits the anxious student; on the right sits the calm student.
shots.camera_movement: Wide shot establishing the two personalities.
shots.psychological_intent:
A familiar, relatable campus environment where everyone has seen this exact power dynamic play out.

---

shots.title: The Desperate Over-Achiever
shots.spoken_clause: One student is desperate for an A-plus. He stays up until three in the morning formatting slides, worrying about fonts, and sweating every detail.
shots.visual_composition_16_9: Close-up on the frantic student at 3:00 AM. Three coffee mugs stacked up, red bloodshot ink eyes, frantic clicking on slide formatting tools, posture completely crumpled.
shots.color_accent: Red indicator warnings on his screen (`#FF3B30`).
shots.camera_movement: Jittery push-in matching his caffeine jitters.
shots.psychological_intent:
Captures the agony of over-investment.

---

shots.title: The B-Minus Guy
shots.spoken_clause: The other student leans back in his chair, glances at the project, and says, 'A B-minus is fine with me. I have other priorities.'
shots.visual_composition_16_9: `CHAR_01_SOVEREIGN` leaning back with his hands behind his head, feet propped lightly on the desk corner. He glances at the screen with an unbothered smile, shrugging with zero anxiety.
shots.camera_movement: Slow dolly-in on his relaxed posture.
shots.psychological_intent:
The supreme power of having alternative priorities.

---

shots.title: Who Holds The Frame?
shots.spoken_clause: Who controls the frame of that project?
shots.visual_composition_16_9: Clean cream canvas with a hand-drawn golden picture frame around the words: `"WHO HOLDS THE FRAME?"`.
shots.camera_movement: Hard snap zoom onto the center.
shots.psychological_intent:
Prompts active viewer engagement before delivering the answer.

---

shots.title: The Power of Caring Less
shots.spoken_clause: The person who cares less.
shots.visual_composition_16_9: Medium shot of `CHAR_01_SOVEREIGN` closing his notebook and packing his bag. The frantic student is looking up at him wide-eyed, completely helpless to argue.
shots.camera_movement: Static hold.
shots.psychological_intent:
Uncompromising, concise truth.

---

shots.title: The Walking Away Power
shots.spoken_clause: The person who is comfortable walking away sets the rules.
shots.visual_composition_16_9: Wide shot of an open glass doorway. The sovereign student walks through it into the sunlight, while the classroom door stays open. His footsteps leave calm, steady ink prints.
shots.camera_movement: Slow push toward the bright doorway.
shots.psychological_intent:
The foundational rule of negotiation and personal dignity.

---

shots.title: The Unspoken Broadcast
shots.spoken_clause: When you constantly make yourself available to someone, you communicate a hidden signal without saying a single word.
shots.visual_composition_16_9: `CHAR_02_OVERGIVER` standing in a room. Invisible red radio frequency waves broadcast continuously from his chest in 360 degrees, sending a flashing text pulse: `[I HAVE NOTHING ELSE]`.
shots.camera_movement: Orbit around the emitting figure.
shots.psychological_intent:
Shows that neediness radiates non-verbally.

---

shots.title: The Empty Calendar
shots.spoken_clause: You communicate that your calendar is empty.
shots.visual_composition_16_9: Close-up on a wall calendar where Monday through Sunday are completely blank white boxes with tumbleweed blowing across them.
shots.camera_movement: Pan across the empty week.
shots.psychological_intent:
Concrete visualization of zero life traction.

---

shots.title: No Compelling Passions
shots.spoken_clause: You communicate that you have no pressing goals, no compelling passions, and no other options.
shots.visual_composition_16_9: A character sitting in the middle of an empty room staring at a blank wall, while other doors labeled `"MISSION"`, `"CRAFT"`, `"FRIENDS"` are locked with cobwebs.
shots.camera_movement: Pull-back emphasizing loneliness and lack of purpose.
shots.psychological_intent:
Highlights the root cause of over-availability—an absence of personal purpose.

---

shots.title: The Orbiting Satellite
shots.spoken_clause: You communicate that your entire world revolves around whether this one person grants you their favor.
shots.visual_composition_16_9: Astronomical diagram: In the center, `CHAR_03_OBSERVER` is drawn as a glowing Earth. `CHAR_02_OVERGIVER` is drawn as a tiny, helpless satellite locked in a frantic, tight orbit around her, unable to break away.
shots.camera_movement: Revolving camera following the desperate orbit.
shots.psychological_intent:
Striking cosmic metaphor of losing one's own center of gravity.

---

shots.title: Total Availability = Desperation
shots.spoken_clause: And to the human subconscious, total availability looks dangerously close to desperation.
shots.visual_composition_16_9: Two bold words across the canvas connected by an equal sign: `"TOTAL AVAILABILITY = DESPERATION"`. The word `"DESPERATION"` vibrates slightly with red ink distortion.
shots.camera_movement: Hard snap zoom.
shots.psychological_intent:
The brutal cognitive equation decoded.

---

shots.title: The Cornering Salesman
shots.spoken_clause: Think about how you feel when a salesperson in a shopping mall corners you.
shots.visual_composition_16_9: A shopping mall corridor. `CHAR_04_SALESMAN` steps directly into the walking path of a pedestrian, holding up lotion bottles and flyer sheets, blocking the way.
shots.camera_movement: Medium shot tracking the pedestrian being cut off.
shots.psychological_intent:
Anchors the concept in a universal social annoyance everyone has felt.

---

shots.title: The Forced Smile & The Follow
shots.spoken_clause: They smile too broadly. They follow you down the aisle. They offer you discounts before you even inspect the price tag.
shots.visual_composition_16_9: The salesman is walking backward in front of the shopper, grinning frantically, pointing to a massive cardboard sign: `"-70% OFF! PLEASE TAKE IT!"`.
shots.camera_movement: Tracking backward matching the salesman's frantic steps.
shots.psychological_intent:
Over-eager courtship feels identical to desperate salesmanship.

---

shots.title: The Immediate Reflex: Backing Away
shots.spoken_clause: Even if the product they are selling is decent, what is your immediate reflex? You want to back away. You feel suspicious.
shots.visual_composition_16_9: Close-up on the shopper's face. Eyes squinting in suspicion, shoulders rising, hands held up in a polite `"No thanks"` barrier, looking for an emergency exit.
shots.camera_movement: Push-in on the defensive posture.
shots.psychological_intent:
Demonstrates that the suspicion was triggered by the seller's desperation, not the product quality.

---

shots.title: The Hidden Defect Suspicion
shots.spoken_clause: You think to yourself: 'If this jacket is so incredible, why are they practically begging me to take it?'
shots.visual_composition_16_9: The shopper holds up a leather jacket, looking underneath the collar with a magnifying glass, searching for hidden tears or defects.
shots.camera_movement: Macro zoom through the magnifying lens.
shots.psychological_intent:
Human intuition assumes that anything offered for free must be broken.

---

shots.title: The Invisible Trap
shots.spoken_clause: Desperate enthusiasm always feels like an invisible trap. It signals that the seller needs something from you more than you need something from them.
shots.visual_composition_16_9: The salesman holds out a gift box tied with a gold ribbon. But under the table, the box is connected by an invisible steel chain and bear trap around the recipient’s ankle.
shots.camera_movement: Slow vertical pan revealing the hidden trap below the desk.
shots.psychological_intent:
Exposes why people-pleasing feels manipulative: it carries an unspoken debt of required gratitude.

---

shots.title: The Signal of Self-Sufficiency
shots.spoken_clause: When a person ignores you, or simply doesn't rush to cater to your every mood, they trigger the exact opposite reaction. They signal emotional self-sufficiency.
shots.visual_composition_16_9: `CHAR_01_SOVEREIGN` sitting in a café window table. He takes a slow sip of coffee, looks out at the rainy street, and turns a page of his book. He is completely, peacefully content in his own presence.
shots.camera_movement: Slow tracking shot passing outside the café window looking in.
shots.psychological_intent:
Contrast with the salesman: the sovereign person sells nothing, demands nothing, and therefore looks infinitely attractive.

---

shots.title: Your Absence Won’t Break Me
shots.spoken_clause: They communicate that while your presence might be welcome, your absence will not shatter their existence.
shots.visual_composition_16_9: Wide shot. `CHAR_03_OBSERVER` stands near the table saying goodbye. `CHAR_01_SOVEREIGN` smiles warmly, gives a genuine, friendly wave: `"Have a great evening."` He turns right back to his reading without lingering or staring at her back.
shots.camera_movement: Static hold as the girl walks away, looking back once in surprise.
shots.psychological_intent:
The definition of emotional maturity: welcoming connection, but immune to abandonment panic.

---

shots.title: Having Your Own Orbit
shots.spoken_clause: They have their own orbit. They are not auditioning for your approval. And because they refuse to sell themselves, you immediately assume the product must be of immense value.
shots.visual_composition_16_9: A golden celestial body with its own steady orbital rings. Other smaller satellites are drawn naturally into its orbit without it moving an inch. A golden stamp appears: `[INTRINSIC VALUE: UNMEASURABLE]`.
shots.color_accent: Radiant amber and gold ring glow (`#F59E0B`).
shots.camera_movement: Epic cosmic zoom-out.
shots.psychological_intent:
Triumphant climax of Chapter 3—sovereignty creates natural gravity.

---
